description: Defines the ReactAgentController class for managing state and interactions within a Flutter UI component related to the React Agent feature. It acts as a controller to handle user input, communicate with the AgentService, and provide data and icons for UI rendering.

classes.name: ReactAgentController
classes.description: A Flutter ChangeNotifier that manages the state of the React Agent screen, handling user input, agent steps, and interaction with the AgentService.

methods.name: ReactAgentController
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the controller with an optional AgentService and sets up a listener for agent state changes.

methods.name: _onAgentChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when the AgentService updates its state, synchronizing local state with the service.

methods.name: startAgent
methods.description: Initiates the agent's operation based on the current user input; shows an error if the input is empty.

methods.name: clearSteps
methods.description: Clears the current steps, error messages, and user input.

methods.name: setUserInput
methods.description: Updates the user input string and notifies listeners.

methods.name: getStepIcon
methods.description: Returns an icon based on the step type.

methods.name: getStepColor
methods.description: Returns a color associated with the step type.

methods.name: getStepTitle
methods.description: Returns a string title for the step type, including an emoji.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Removes the listener from the AgentService and disposes of the controller.
